DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 掲示板について、お気づきの点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you noticed anything about the noticeboard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日付が過ぎた催しの紙があります。新しい情報を知っているので、私の紙を上から貼って直してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去日付の掲示へ自作新情報を重ねてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a flyer for an event whose date has passed. I know some new information; may I fix it by sticking my own sheet over it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may cover an outdated notice with your own new information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で貼り替えず、管理担当へご相談ください。今はまだ貼っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consult the manager rather than replacing it yourself. You haven't put anything up yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。催しの主催者から新しい日を聞いたのではなく、友達から聞いた情報でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未貼付で新日付は主催者でなく友人から聞いたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I heard the new date from a friend, not from the event organizer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not posted it and heard the new date from a friend rather than the organizer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 掲示の管理と、情報の確認を分ける必要があります。どの掲示か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to separate managing the notices from verifying the information. Please show me which notice it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右下の紙です。古い日付は見えますが、変更のお知らせを別に貼っているかまでは探していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右下の掲示を示し別の変更案内の有無は未確認と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The sheet at the bottom right. I can see the old date, but I haven't looked to see whether a separate notice of a change has been posted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the bottom-right notice and say you have not checked for a separate change notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。古い紙を剥がしたり、他の案内を隠したりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will check. Please don't remove the old sheet or cover other notices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。貼替え用のテープはしまいます。友達の話を、主催者の公式案内のようには書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: テープをしまい友人情報を主催者発表として書かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll put away the tape for replacing it. I won't write my friend's information as if it were the organizer's official announcement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will put away the tape and will not present a friend's information as the organizer's announcement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 掲示の状態と、気づいた点を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person responsible about the state of the notice and what you noticed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付の過ぎた紙が残っていると報告します。新しい日が正しいかは主催者の案内で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い掲示を報告し新日付は主催者案内で確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report that an outdated flyer is still there. I'll check the organizer's announcement to see whether the new date is correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report the old notice and verify the new date through the organizer's announcement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。それでは、掲示の確認はこちらで行います。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. We will check the notice here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物から何か漏れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is something leaking from your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 水筒のふたが緩んで、お茶が床へこぼれました。かばんだけ拭いて行くつもりでしたが、床も濡れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水筒の茶が床へ漏れ荷物だけでなく床も濡れたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lid of my flask came loose and tea spilled onto the floor. I was going to wipe just my bag and leave, but the floor is wet too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that tea leaked from your flask onto the floor, wetting both your belongings and the floor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 濡れた場所を教えてください。これ以上漏れないようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the wet area. Can you stop any further leakage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここから柱の前までです。水筒は立てて持ち、かばんを振って中身を出すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 柱までの範囲を示し水筒を立てて持つと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: From here to in front of that pillar. I'll hold the flask upright and won't shake the bag to empty it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the area up to the pillar and explain that you will hold the flask upright. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係員が床の状態を確認します。通る方の邪魔にならない場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check the floor. Please wait somewhere that doesn't obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この脇へ寄ります。自分のタオルで全部済んだと判断せず、濡れた範囲をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 脇へ寄り自己のタオルだけで処理完了とはせず範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move to the side here. I won't assume my own towel has dealt with everything; I'll show you the wet area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move aside and say you will show the area rather than consider it dealt with using only your towel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列車のご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you planning to catch a train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もうすぐ乗る予定です。ただ、知らないふりで立ち去らず、場所を伝えてから移動できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発車が近いが濡れた場所を報告後に移動可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm due to board soon. But instead of pretending I don't know and leaving, I want to report the location and ask whether I can then move on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say departure is near, but you will report the wet area and then ask whether you may leave. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 床の対応は係員へ引き継ぎます。ご自身のお荷物も、漏れが続かないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll hand the floor cleanup over to a staff member. Please also check that your luggage is no longer leaking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ふたを確認して、濡れた物を分けます。床の場所はお伝えしたので、乗る列車の案内も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ふたと濡れ物を確認し引継ぎ後に列車案内を見ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the lid and separate the wet items. Since I've told you where the floor is wet, I'll also check the information for my train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the lid and wet items, then check train information after handing the matter over. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで床を確認します。お知らせありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the floor here. Thank you for letting us know. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どなたの連絡先についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Whose contact details are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同窓会を開きたくて、昔の友達の住所を探しています。市内に住んでいれば、ここで教えてもらえると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同窓会用に旧友の市内住所を窓口で聞けると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to organize a school reunion and am looking for an old friend's address. I thought you could tell me here if they lived in this city.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the counter could provide an old friend's city address for a reunion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様のご事情だけで住所をお知らせすることはできません。ご本人へ連絡する手がかりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot disclose an address solely because of your circumstances. Do you have any way to contact the person directly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 以前のメールがありますが、今も使っているかは分かりません。住所を調べる許可を本人にもらったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧メールの有効性と本人の許可は未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an old email address, but I don't know whether they still use it. They haven't given me permission to look up their address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not confirmed that the old email works or obtained the person's permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まずご本人や、連絡を取り次げる方へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please first contact the person or someone who can pass a message along.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 共通の友達に、住所を私へ渡してと頼むのでなく、同窓会の案内を本人へ伝えてもらおうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共通友人へ住所提供でなく案内取次ぎを頼むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask a mutual friend to pass the reunion invitation to them, rather than ask the friend to give me their address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask a mutual friend to forward an invitation rather than provide an address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返答するかどうかも、ご本人に決めていただく形ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: So the person would also decide whether to respond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。参加したい人から連絡をもらう方法にします。参加しない人の住所を集めたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 参加希望者から返事をもらい不参加者の住所は集めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll arrange for those who want to attend to contact me. I'm not trying to collect addresses of people who aren't attending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will receive replies from interested attendees and will not collect nonattendees' addresses. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行政の手続きが必要な別のご事情がある場合は、担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have another reason requiring an administrative procedure, please consult the relevant staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は同窓会の連絡だけです。市役所に名簿を作ってもらうつもりはなく、自分の案内方法を変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用件は同窓会のみで行政に名簿作成を依頼しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today it's only about reunion invitations. I don't intend to have city hall make a list; I'll change how I send the invitations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your only purpose is the reunion and you are not asking the administration to compile a list. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご用件を確認しました。それでは、ご本人へ届く連絡方法をご検討ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand your request. Please consider a way for your message to reach the person. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 痛みの書き方について、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having difficulty describing your pain on the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 選ぶ言葉が分かりません。「特になし」に丸を付けましたが、何も感じないわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表現が選べず症状なしと記入したが感覚はあると申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't know which word to choose. I circled “none in particular,” but that doesn't mean I feel nothing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you marked no symptoms because you couldn't choose an expression, although you do feel something. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どんな感じか、ご自身の言葉でお話しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you describe the sensation in your own words?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この辺りが、何かで押されているように感じます。刺すような感じではなく、うまく一語で言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 刺す感じでなく押される感じと自分の言葉で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around here, it feels as though something is pressing on me. It's not a stabbing sensation, and I can't express it well in one word.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in your own words that it feels like pressure rather than stabbing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 決まった言葉へ無理に当てはめず、その説明を担当へお伝えください。いつ感じますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't force it into a set term; tell the person in charge that description. When do you feel it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝から、動かなくても時々感じます。ずっと同じ強さなのかは、まだ整理できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝から安静時も時々で強さの経過は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Since this morning, I sometimes feel it even when I'm not moving. I haven't yet worked out whether it stays at the same intensity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it has occurred intermittently since this morning, even at rest, and you are unsure how its intensity has changed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部位や経過も、分かる範囲で診察時にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: During your consultation, please also describe the location and course as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。選択肢が分からず「なし」にしたことも話します。痛みの名前が分からないので、病気の名前も自分で付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: なしの誤記を伝え不明な感覚へ病名を自分で付けないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll explain that I selected “none” because I didn't understand the choices. Since I don't know the name of the pain, I won't give myself a disease diagnosis either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the mistaken “none” entry and will not assign a disease name to the unfamiliar sensation yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入の直し方をご案内します。説明に使った言葉もメモできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain how to correct the form. Can you also note down the words you used to describe it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「押されているような感じ」と書きます。選べない言葉の代わりに、感じた場所と今朝からのことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の表現で場所と開始時期をメモして伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write “a feeling of being pressed.” Instead of choosing words I don't understand, I'll explain where I feel it and that it started this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note and convey the location and onset in your own words. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご説明を担当へ伝えます。それでは、症状なしの記入を訂正して診察の案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your explanation to the person in charge. Please correct the no-symptoms entry and wait for instructions for your consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの小物は、どなたが拾われましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが拾いました。私が持って来たので、私が見つけたと話してしまいそうでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾ったのは子どもで持参者の自分ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child found it. Since I brought it here, I almost said I was the one who found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your child found it, not you, the person who brought it in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾った場所を、ご自身もご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you also see where it was found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 場所は子どもに教えてもらいました。私はその時、少し離れたベンチにいて、拾うところは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾う場面は見ず場所も子どもから聞いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child told me the location. I was on a bench some distance away then and didn't see them pick it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you did not witness the finding and heard the location from your child. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お子様に分かる範囲でお話しいただき、保護者の方のお話と分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll hear what your child knows and distinguish that from your account as the parent or guardian.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。道の脇にあったそうです。私は後からその場所を一緒に見ましたが、最初から見ていたことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後から一緒に場所を見た事実を最初の目撃と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Apparently it was beside the path. I went to see the place with my child afterward, but I won't say I saw it from the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish seeing the place together afterward from witnessing the initial discovery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらへ来るまで、どなたが品物を持っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Who held the item on the way here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中から私が持ちました。子どもが拾ったことと、私が運んだことを分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子どもの拾得と途中から自分が運んだ役割を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I carried it from partway here. I'll distinguish my child's finding it from my carrying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your child's role in finding the item from your role carrying it partway. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お子様が覚えていない点は、無理に答えを決めずお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your child doesn't remember something, please say so rather than force an answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。時刻を覚えていないのに、私の時計の見当を子どもの記憶として答えたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明時刻を親の推測で子どもの記憶として答えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If my child doesn't remember the time, I won't present my estimate from my watch as their memory.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not give the parent's estimate of an unknown time as the child's recollection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お二人の確認した範囲を伺います。それでは、こちらでお話しください。お届けありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll ask what each of you has confirmed. Please tell us here. Thank you for bringing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の表面について、確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something you want to check about the front of the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切手が剥がれないよう、上から透明なテープを貼りました。これでそのまま送れるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切手保護の透明テープを貼った未投函封筒の使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put clear tape over the stamp so it wouldn't come off. I'd like to ask whether I can send it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using an unposted envelope with clear tape over the stamp for protection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切手が貼られた状態を担当が確認します。もう投函した物ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge will check how the stamp is attached. This hasn't been posted yet, has it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 未投函です。透明なら見えるのでよいと思いましたが、貼り方の扱いまでは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 透明で見えるからよいと思い扱いは未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it hasn't. I thought it would be fine because you can see through the tape, but I haven't checked the rules about attaching it this way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you assumed transparency made it acceptable but have not checked how this is treated. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理に剥がして切手や封筒を破らず、今の状態をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show it as it is, without forcibly peeling it off and tearing the stamp or envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。さらにテープを重ねて丈夫にするのでなく、このまま相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無理に剥がさずテープも重ねないで現状を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll consult you as it is rather than add more tape to make it stronger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will show its current state without forcibly peeling the tape off or adding more. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中の手紙は封筒から出せる状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you take the letter out of the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ封をしていません。別の封筒が必要なら手紙を移せますが、今の切手をどう扱うかも先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未封で移し替え可能だが切手の扱いも先に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't sealed it yet. I can transfer the letter if another envelope is needed, but I'll first ask how to handle the stamp too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the envelope is unsealed and the letter can be moved, but you will also ask about the stamp first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切手と発送方法の取扱いを確認してから、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll advise you after checking the handling of the stamp and the mailing method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。見えることだけで使えると決めず、今回の貼り方を見てもらって準備し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見えるだけで使用可能とせず確認後に準備を直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't decide it's usable just because it's visible; I'll have this attachment checked and prepare it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume visibility means usability and will prepare it again after checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状態を確認できる窓口へご案内します。それでは、そのままお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll direct you to a counter where they can check its condition. Please keep it as it is and bring it along. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 提出するメモの番号について、ご確認ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check the number on the note you are submitting, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座番号の欄へ三桁の番号を書きました。支店の横にあったので、これが私の口座だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支店横の三桁を本人の口座番号欄へ書いたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote a three-digit number in the account-number field. It was beside the branch name, so I thought it was my account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the three digits beside the branch in your account-number field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 欄の名称を資料で照らし合わせましょう。数字の長さだけで正しい情報を決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the field names with the document. Don't decide information is correct solely by the number of digits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここは支店番号でした。自分の口座番号を探す前に、目立つ数字を書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支店番号の欄を読み目立つ数字を写した誤りを認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This was the branch-number field. I copied the prominent number before looking for my own account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the branch-number field and acknowledge the error of copying the prominent number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行名、支店名、口座の種類、口座番号など、提出先が求める項目を分けて確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check separately the bank name, branch name, account type, account number, and other details the recipient requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の用紙を持っています。項目を一つずつ照合し、支店番号を口座番号へ足して一つの長い番号にもしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社用紙の項目を別々に照合し番号同士を連結しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the company's form. I'll check each item individually, and I don't want to add the branch number to the account number to make one long number either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the company form's fields separately and not concatenate the numbers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料の見方を担当がご案内します。メモはまだ会社へ提出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain how to read the document. You haven't submitted the note to your company yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 未提出です。コピーもまだ送っていないので、元の情報を確かめてから直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まだ未提出かつ未送信で元情報を確認して直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I haven't sent a copy either, so I'll check the original information before correcting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it has neither been submitted nor sent and you will correct it after checking the original information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記載を直した後も、名前と口座の情報をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After correcting it, please also check the name and account details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。支店と本人の口座を分け、各欄の名称を見て書き直します。直したメモだけを提出用にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 欄名と本人情報を確認し訂正メモを提出用にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll distinguish the branch from my own account and rewrite it by checking each field name. I'll use only the corrected note for submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check field names and your own information and use the corrected note for submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認したい項目を担当へ伝えます。それでは、資料と用紙をお持ちのままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge which items you want to check. Please wait with the document and form in hand. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その箱は、売場の見本として置いているものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: That box is placed there as a shop display sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中にお菓子が入っていると思い、かごへ入れました。贈り物にしたいので、実際に買う商品を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本箱を中身入りと思いかごへ入れ贈答品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought it contained sweets and put it in my basket. I'd like it as a gift, so please show me the actual product to buy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you put the sample box in your basket thinking it contained goods, and ask about the gift product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの見本は空箱です。ご希望の詰め合わせは、この表示の物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This sample is an empty box. Is the assortment you want the one shown on this label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この組合せです。箱の大きさだけ見て、何が何個入るかは確認していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望の組合せを示し箱だけで数量を見ていなかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this combination. I only looked at the box size and didn't check which items or how many were included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the desired assortment and say you looked only at the box without checking quantities. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身と数量をご案内し、購入できる品があるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain the contents and quantities and check whether there is a product available to buy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。見本の箱を持っただけで一箱確保されたと思わず、実際の商品を見てから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見本所持を確保済とせず実物確認後に選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I won't assume a box has been reserved just because I'm holding the sample; I'll decide after seeing the actual product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say holding the sample does not mean a product is reserved, and you will choose after checking the actual item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装のご希望もございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you also like it wrapped?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手渡しするので包装を頼みたいです。ただ、包んでから中身の数が違うと気づかないよう、先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手渡し包装希望だが包む前に中身数量を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll give it in person, so I'd like gift wrapping. But I'll check first so I don't discover the quantity is wrong after it's wrapped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want wrapping for a gift handed over in person but want to check the contents and quantities beforehand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際の品と、表示の内容を照合してから包装をご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can discuss wrapping after comparing the actual product with the information on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。見本はお返しし、購入品の中身と価格を確認した後で包装をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本を返し実際の内容と価格の確認後に包装を頼むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll return the sample and ask for wrapping after checking the contents and price of the product I'm buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return the sample and request wrapping after checking the actual contents and price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見本はお預かりします。それでは、商品の確認まで少々お待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take the sample. Please wait a moment while we check the product. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園内で何をされるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What are you planning to do in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達との思い出を箱に入れて埋めたいです。空いている土の場所なら、少し掘ってよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記念箱を空いた土へ埋めてよいか掘る前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to put memories with friends in a box and bury it. I thought it would be all right to dig a little in an empty patch of soil.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before digging, ask whether you may bury a keepsake box in an empty patch of soil. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公園の土を掘る前に、管理担当へご相談ください。もう穴を掘りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consult the management before digging in the park. Have you already dug a hole?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。小さなスコップは持っていますが、箱も土へ置いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スコップはあるが穴も掘らず箱も未設置と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I have a small shovel, but I haven't even placed the box on the ground.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a shovel but have neither dug a hole nor placed the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 何を、いつまで置きたいとお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: What would you like to leave there, and for how long?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手紙と写真を入れ、五年後に開けたいです。でも、自分たちの予定だけでその場所を使い続けられるとは限りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手紙と写真を五年保管したいが場所利用は自分だけで決められないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd put letters and photos in it and open it in five years. But our plans alone don't mean we can keep using that spot, do they?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to store letters and photos for five years but cannot decide on use of the location by yourselves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 埋める計画や、物を置く取扱いは担当の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible needs to check your burial plan and the handling of items left there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。許可がなければ箱は持ち帰ります。家で保管して、ここでは記念写真だけ撮る方法も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不許可なら持帰り自宅保管と記念写真の代案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Without permission, I'll take the box home. I'll also consider keeping it at home and only taking a commemorative photo here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take it home if permission is denied and propose home storage and a commemorative photo instead. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 道具をしまい、掘らない状態でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put away your tool and wait without digging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。スコップを袋へ戻しました。思い出を作ることと、公園へ物を埋めることを分けて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具をしまい思い出作りと埋設の利用を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've put the shovel back in its bag. I'll discuss making memories separately from burying something in the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have put away the tool and will discuss making memories separately from use of the park for burial. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご計画を担当へお伝えします。それでは、箱をお手元に持ってお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your plan to the person responsible. Please keep the box with you and wait. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紙の切符をご利用でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using a paper ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。買い物のレシートと一緒に持っています。まとめて入れたら必要な券だけ読み取られると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 券と買物レシートの束を機械で自動選別すると思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm holding it together with shopping receipts. I thought if I inserted them together, the machine would read only the required ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought the machine would automatically sort a bundle of tickets and shopping receipts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な乗車券を確認し、レシートとは分けてください。まだ機械へ入れていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please identify the required travel ticket and separate it from the receipts. You haven't put them in the machine yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。束のままですとどれが券か自分でも見えていないので、脇で整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投入の束を通路脇で整理したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. In the bundle, I can't even see which one is the ticket, so I'll sort them out to the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to sort the uninserted bundle beside the passage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路を空けた場所でお確かめください。券の行き先と日付もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check them somewhere that leaves the passage clear. Also look at the ticket's destination and date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この一枚です。日付と行き先は今日の予定です。値段が書いてある紙なら全部同じではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車券の行先と日付を確かめ紙の金額表示だけで分類しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's this one. The date and destination match today's plans. So not every paper with a price printed on it is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the ticket's destination and date and say you will not classify papers solely by a printed amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご利用になる券の扱いは、案内に沿って確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please follow the instructions to check how to use your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシートは別のポケットへ入れました。複数の切符が必要か分からない場合も、紙を全部入れず先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートを分け複数券の要否不明なら投入前に聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put the receipts in a separate pocket. If I'm unsure whether multiple tickets are needed, I'll ask first instead of inserting all the papers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have separated the receipts and will ask before inserting anything if unsure whether multiple tickets are required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備できましたら、係員の案内に従ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you're ready, please proceed according to the staff's directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗車用の一枚だけを確認しました。ほかの紙はしまい、案内を見てから通ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要な一枚を確認し他紙をしまい案内後に通ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've identified just the one ticket for travel. I'll put away the other papers and go through after checking the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have checked the one required ticket, put away other papers, and will proceed after receiving guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 券を分けていただきありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for separating your ticket. Have a safe journey.
